REJECTED (structural no-op): down-weighting the no-IDF sparse leg to 0.25 produced BYTE-IDENTICAL retrieval metrics to the 1.0/1.0 control on both Vietnamese splits (120 q each). Root cause verified in code: chunk.hybrid_search returns sorted_results[:limit] but SearchService.search (src/domain/search_service.py:199) immediately re-scores every fused candidate with rerank_chunks_with_scores and sorts by THAT lexical score, discarding the RRF order entirely. Both legs return >=16 candidates that all survive into the reranker top-16, so the dense/sparse weight ratio cannot change final membership or order. RRF weighting cannot help until the lexical reranker is replaced. No code change; RAG_FUSION_*_WEIGHT settings already default to 1.0/1.0 (behaviour-preserving), added in this iteration as inert knobs.
